notes: relevant_docs is the retrieval ground truth: the documents that actually contain the answer.
must_contain lets scripts/validate_goldset.py prove each annotation against the corpus text, so the labels are checkable rather than asserted.
answerable=false entries have no supporting document anywhere in the corpus. Correct behaviour is refusal, not an answer; they measure abstention.
judgment_0004/0006 and judgment_0122/0125 are duplicate case pairs present in input/. Both copies are listed as relevant where applicable, because both are legitimately correct retrievals.
